Plans.Filter: ((slot_at >= '2026-10-07 19:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (status = ANY ('{complete,partial}'::text[])) AND (deadline_at < (now() - '8 days'::interval)))

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX fuel_station_latest_state ON public.fuel_station_latest USING btree (((station #>> '{address,region}'::text[])))

CREATE INDEX fuel_station_latest_membership_state ON public.fuel_station_latest USING btree (((station #>> '{address,region}'::text[]))) WHERE (lower(replace(replace(TRIM(BOTH FROM (station ->> 'name'::text)), ''''::text, ''::text), '’'::text, ''::text)) ~ '^(costco|sams|bjs)'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fuel_station_latest_pkey ON public.fuel_station_latest USING btree (station_id)
CREATE INDEX fuel_station_latest_location ON public.fuel_station_latest USING btree (latitude, longitude)
CREATE INDEX fuel_station_latest_job_id ON public.fuel_station_latest USING btree (job_id)
